body: Fixed 2026-10-16 (f8ea7ef, found by the input-space tests): a failing token_cmd that echoed its token leaked it through stderr into agx's error message; agx now redacts the resolved value from errors. Known limit: a token printed only to a command's stderr (never resolved) cannot be redacted. Also fixed then: `login add --replace` dropped the account and kind (now kept).
